title: Nested Typed Arrays Brick Godot
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: Godot v4.6.stable.mono 

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable.mono - Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS 24.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (RADV NAVI32) - AMD Ryzen 9 7900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 30.46 GiB memory

### Issue description

Nested Typed arrays brick Godot under weirdly specific conditions. 

- Have a node with at least two exported typed arrays. One must be a nested array.
- Use ```func _validate_property(property: Dictionary) :``` to define the nested typed array.
- Add self (node with attached script) to both variables in the editor
- When saving Godot will freeze


```gdscript
@tool
extends Node3D

@export var BrokenArray: Array[Node3D]
@export var BrokenNestArray: Array

func _validate_property(property: Dictionary) -> void:
	if property.name == "BrokenNestArray":
		property.hint = PROPERTY_HINT_TYPE_STRING
		property.hint_string = "%d:%d/%d:%s" % [TYPE_ARRAY,TYPE_OBJECT,PROPERTY_HINT_NODE_TYPE,"Node3D"]
```

This also works for dictionaries with array values, but all of the listed conditions must happen. If you only add the self node to one variable and save nothing will happen. But if you add the node to the second array and try to save, everything freezes. Godot doesn't immediately crash, it just stays at 100% save for a while then crashes. I really don't understand how two separate variables can affect each other. 

### Steps to reproduce

From attached project:

- Open TestScene
- Add Self3D (root node) to any two variables
- Save
